relation_to_current_tournament.useful_result: The tournament compares explicit finite anti-thing candidates under several packet-relative viability and presumption frontiers and preserves a non-winner result.
scope_mismatch_with_next_contract: The current packet exhausts only its smaller frozen candidate grammar and only through cardinality three, with named boundary cases at cardinality four.
It does not implement the proposed Packet A grammars for partial operations, free bracketed terms, magmas, associative quotients, PSD carriers, or complex density operators.
It does not implement the proposed drive, Purgatory re-offer loop, repair, new-distinction, or later-constraint-generation obligations.

PyTorch was preregistered out of the current packet because it carried no tensor, graph-learning, or differentiable claim; therefore this packet cannot satisfy the new three-runtime next-run contract.

operational_gaps: The single cardinality range 1..5 is not a tractable exhaustive bound for every listed grammar: there are 2^(n^2) labelled binary relations and n^(n^2) total binary operations before quotienting, while PSD and density-operator candidate spaces are continuous.
Each grammar needs its own exact enumeration, canonical quotient, rational-grid, named-boundary, or preregistered sampling envelope; one cardinality list is not a complete finite execution bound.

Random behavioral classes need an explicit distribution, seed, duplicate policy, and cross-grammar allocation. There is no representation-independent uniform distribution over the heterogeneous population.
Repair, new usable distinctions, and later constraint generation are not yet executable predicates and must return HOLD until separately defined.
A real Purgatory re-offer test requires at least two frozen contexts plus a declared material-context delta and dependency fingerprint.
The no-NumPy rule must distinguish prohibited project-level shared implementation from transitive library internals used by JAX or PyTorch.

PyTorch should own claim-bearing tensor, graph, PSD, density, or robustness checks where those objects exist; wrapping every finite candidate in PyTorch would be decorative rather than independent evidence.
next_contract.minimum_safe_amendment: Freeze grammar-specific bounds and HOLD semantics before code runs; keep the broad contract as a campaign map rather than pretending the full cross-product is one executable enumeration.

anti_teleology_reconciliation.static_form: For histories H, independently specified constraints Gamma, restriction rho_t, and present p, the compatible family is F_(Gamma,p) = H_Gamma intersect rho_t^-1(p).
anti_teleology_reconciliation.earned_interpretation: Reverse enumeration exposes a common preimage or fiber of compatible histories. It does not establish backward causation or a future goal pulling histories.
anti_teleology_reconciliation.phrase_rejected_as_literal_causation: many possible futures create the present
anti_teleology_reconciliation.safer_statement: The present under shared constraints is compatible with, and can be characterized by, a plurality of continuations; those continuations do not cause the present merely by being possible.
anti_teleology_reconciliation.constitutive_reading: If create means constitute rather than temporally or efficiently cause, a present may be proposed as an equivalence class of admissible histories that share the same restriction. The plurality of continuations then helps define the modal structure of the present without acting backward from an endpoint. This is an ontological proposal, not an earned result.
anti_teleology_reconciliation.circularity_guard: Conditioning on a chosen p makes rho_t^-1(p) a tautological fiber and cannot explain why p occurs. A claim-bearing test must freeze Gamma and rho_t, enumerate or sample the full image rho_t(H_Gamma), and select any high-multiplicity or invariant present structure by preregistered rules before identifying it with the observed present.
anti_teleology_reconciliation.anti_teleology_as_meta_constraint: Anti-teleology may constrain admissible explanations by forbidding endpoint-coded objectives, post-hoc survivor selection, and future states from receiving causal privilege. It is not itself a dynamical force unless an executable update law is separately defined.
attractor_requirements: a frozen state space and update law
a demonstrated open basin or declared measure-theoretic analogue
robustness to perturbations of constraints and initial conditions
controls separating dynamics from an imposed history measure or endpoint filter
anti_teleology_reconciliation.cosmological_claim_ceiling: The construction supplies a candidate ontological schema for constraint-conditioned explanation. The bounded tournament neither proves a philosophical cosmological argument nor tests physical cosmogenesis.

external_advisory_reviews.advisory_finding: Treat compatible futures as a derived modal or explanatory family, not as causes of the present; a static fiber is not an attractor basin.
